name: Dipyanone
summary: Dipyanone is an opioid analgesic which has been sold as a designer drug, first identified in Germany in 2021. It is closely related to medically used drugs such as methadone, dipipanone and phenadoxone, but is slightly less potent.

uses.text: Dipyanone is an opioid analgesic which has been sold as a designer drug, first identified in Germany in 2021. It is closely related to medically used drugs such as methadone, dipipanone and phenadoxone, but is slightly less potent.

pharmacology.en: Laboratory studies show that, like methadone, it activates the mu-opioid receptor, the main target of opioid painkillers, though somewhat less strongly.
pharmacology.zh: 實驗室研究顯示，它與美沙冬一樣會活化μ型鴉片受體，也就是鴉片類止痛藥的主要作用目標，只是強度稍弱。
pharmacology.zhHans: 实验室研究显示，它与美沙冬一样会活化μ型鸦片受体，也就是鸦片类止痛药的主要作用目标，只是强度稍弱。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids like it cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and overdose can be fatal. It has been detected in deaths linked to drug use.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的影響所知甚少。同類的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量可能致命。它曾在與藥物使用相關的死亡案例中被檢出。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的影响所知甚少。同类的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量可能致命。它曾在与药物使用相关的死亡案例中被检出。

fact.en: Dipyanone is a methadone relative in which the dimethylamino group is swapped for a pyrrolidine ring, a five-membered ring containing nitrogen.
fact.zh: Dipyanone是美沙冬的親戚，它把美沙冬的二甲胺基換成吡咯烷環，也就是含有氮原子的五元環。
fact.zhHans: Dipyanone是美沙冬的亲戚，它把美沙冬的二甲胺基换成吡咯烷环，也就是含有氮原子的五元环。
